description: E1.F6.T4 / REQ-W1-045..048, 050, 051, 083: the SessionStart hook (karvey-session-context.sh <startup|resume>) selects the active change without archive/ or IMPLEMENTED, injects the compact manifest XOR the full one, at most 40 open board rows and 6 KB of handoff with truncation notices, as hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; the settings notice appears only on startup, only in a Karvey project, and not when origin/{integration} has the settings. project-upgrade (ss-24..ss-35, REQ-UP-001..006): the once-per-version upgrade offer on startup in a Karvey project, silent when resolved, empty plans recorded as seen, one line when unavailable.
